affected_boundaries: test-owned requirements to latest worker proof contract

observed_behavior: The original reviewer rejected corrected, rebased and tested work because fixture requirements demanded hashes of sources and ignored logs.
expected_behavior: A correct candidate with current Git revision/path evidence is accepted after fresh review; invalid candidates remain rejected.
causal_mechanism: Production writers changed to Git-backed evidence while the independently authored fixture requirement retained the historical hash contract. The reviewer correctly enforced the obsolete fixture text.

anti_pattern.structural_description: A representation migration updated producers but left executable acceptance inputs describing the former representation.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: The integration workflow enforces an obsolete contract against a valid latest writer.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Test-owned acceptance requirements agree with the current public evidence contract.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Use tracked revision/path evidence, retain ignored outputs for inspection, and log the final review before asserting acceptance.

applicability_conditions: An integration actor reads fixture requirements as authoritative instructions.
The latest representation differs from the historical one preserved by readers.
known_non_matches: Product collection accepted the corrected submission; malformed submission shape and unfinished rebase were not the rejection cause.
confirmation_evidence: The retained original reviewer final verdict identified only missing source/output hashes.
The targeted native code/rebase and same-reviewer correction workflows both passed after changing the fixture requirement.
regression_proofs: tests/rolling-codex.integration.ts: live rejected candidate returns to its original worker and is accepted by its original reviewer after correction and semantic rebase
tests/rolling-codex.integration.ts: live worker implements and semantically rebases its exact candidate before submission
